entries.title: Proverbs 11:1
segments: False balances [are] hateful to the LORD; but a just weight [is] His delight.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:2
segments: Pride comes, then shame comes; but with the lowly [is] wisdom.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:3
segments: The integrity of the upright shall guide them; but the crookedness of traitors shall destroy them.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:4
segments: Riches do not profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:5
segments: The righteousness of the perfect shall make his way right, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:6
segments: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but deceivers shall be taken in lust.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:7
segments: When a wicked man dies, his hope shall perish; and the hope of evil ones shall be lost.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:8
segments: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked comes [in] his place.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:9
segments: A hypocrite corrupts [his] neighbor with [his] mouth; but through knowledge the just shall be delivered.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:10
segments: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices; and when the wicked are destroyed, [there is] singing.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:11
segments: By the blessing of the upright the city is lifted up, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:12
segments: One despising his friend lacks heart, but a man of understanding remains silent.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:13
segments: One going with slander is a revealer of secrets, but the faithful of spirit keeps the matter hidden.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:14
segments: Where [there is] no wisdom, the people fall; but in the multitude of wise men [there is] safety.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:15
segments: He who is surety for a stranger shall be ruined; and he who hates suretyship is safe.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:16
segments: A gracious woman keeps honor, and the strong keep riches.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:17
segments: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but [he who is] cruel troubles his own flesh.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:18
segments: The wicked makes a deceitful wage; but one sowing righteousness [has] a sure reward.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:19
segments: So righteousness [tends] to life; but one pursuing evil, [it is] to his own death.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:20
segments: They who are of a perverse heart [are] hateful to the LORD, but the upright in the way [are] His delight.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:21
segments: [Though] hand [join] in hand, the wicked shall not be innocent; but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:22
segments: [Like] a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, [so is] a beautiful woman who turns aside discretion.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:23
segments: The desire of the righteous [is] only good; the hope of the wicked [is] wrath.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:24
segments: There is one who scatters and yet increases; but one who withholds just due [comes] only to poverty.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:25
segments: The soul who gives freely shall be made fat; and he who waters shall also be watered himself.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:26
segments: He who withholds grain, the people shall curse him; but blessing [is] on the head of him who sells.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:27
segments: He who carefully seeks good gets favor; but he who seeks mischief, it shall come to him.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:28
segments: He who trusts in his riches shall fall; but the righteous shall blossom like a branch.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:29
segments: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind; and the fool [shall be] servant to the wise in heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:30
segments: The fruit of the righteous [is] a tree of life; and he who wins souls [is] wise.

entries.title: Proverbs 11:31
segments: Behold, the righteous shall be rewarded in the earth; much more the wicked and the sinner.
